scope: Machining feasibility review of current geometric prototype; no geometry modified
method: Opposing parallel exterior faces under30mm apart; projected overlap area>0.01mm2; exact normal witness segment checked for complete coverage by union of member convex-cell intervals. This is a witnessed local thickness search, not a proof of global minimum web. Reentrant edge count includes boundary mesh subdivisions; no cutter radius or tool access model supplied.
limitations: No actual shop tolerance, cutter diameter/corner radius, reach, holder, axis limits or clamps are modeled.
Stock sizes and grain direction/moisture state have not been verified.
1mm is an exclusion guard parameter, not an asserted minimum residual web.
All surfaces are planar; sharp reentrant corners have no modeled fillets or reliefs.
